text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Peeking into the lesson room, I saw 
Katsuragi Ace enthusiastically practicing 
her dancing.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*, phew... How's that look?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No, compromising isn't right. I've gotta 
polish it until I'm completely satisfied!
choice_data_list:
Being enthusiastic is great, but taking 
breaks is important too.

Being enthusiastic is fine, but resting is 
important too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: 熱心なのもいいけど休憩も大事だぞ
熱心なのもいいけど休憩も大事だよ
choice_data_list_en: Dedication is great, but taking breaks is important too.
Dedication is great, but resting is important too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... It's night already? I wasn't 
looking at the clock at all...
choice_data_list:
You really put a lot of effort into 
dancing, huh.

You really put a lot of effort into 
dancing, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Not just in races"? Ha-ha, it's no wonder 
you'd think that!
choice_data_list: ダンスにもかなり力を入れているんだな
ダンスにもかなり力を入れているんだね
choice_data_list_en: You're really putting a lot of effort into dancing, huh.
You're really putting a lot of effort into dancing, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, for me, the Winning Live is an 
insanely important stage, too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"It's a place where you win races, seize 
center stage, and prove that dreams really 
do come true, right?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Put on a ridiculously cool concert, shine 
brighter than anyone, and then—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Pushing straight ahead with your 
convictions might just make the whole 
audience realize how great that is, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Birth and upbringing don't matter when it 
comes to dreaming! Push forward with 
conviction, and your wishes will come 
true!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I want to convey that from right in the 
center of the stage."
choice_data_list: Ace...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And on that note, I'm heading back to 
practice! Don't worry, I'll wrap up before 
curfew!
choice_data_list: エース……

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And on that note, I'm heading back to 
practice! Don't worry, I'll wrap up before 
curfew!
choice_data_list: ちゃんと休憩してからじゃないと
なら俺も付き合うよ！
なら私も付き合うよ！
choice_data_list_en: Not until you've taken a proper break.
Then I'll come along with you too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ehh...? And here I thought you understood 
what I was getting at.
choice_data_list: ちゃんと休憩してからじゃないと
なら俺も付き合うよ！
なら私も付き合うよ！
choice_data_list_en: Not until you've taken a proper break.
Then I'll come along with you too!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I mean, yeah, but—
choice_data_list: 無理して体を壊したら元も子もないだろ
無理して体を壊したら元も子もないでしょ
choice_data_list_en: Pushing yourself till you wreck your body defeats the whole purpose, doesn't it?
Pushing yourself till you wreck your body defeats the whole purpose, right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, all right, I get it! So stop making 
that worried face.
choice_data_list:
Your legs are tight, so make sure to 
massage them.

Your legs are tight, so make sure to 
massage them, okay?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, now that you mention it, you're 
right. No wonder my footwork felt a step 
behind!
choice_data_list: 脚が張ってるから、マッサージしておいて
脚が張ってるから、マッサージしておいてね
choice_data_list_en: Your legs are tight, so make sure to get them massaged.
Your legs are tight, so make sure to get them massaged, okay?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainer-san, you've been 
keeping a close eye on my legs.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Then let's get some good rest and 
get in top condition!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, having rested sufficiently, 
Katsuragi Ace seemed to deliver a 
performance she was satisfied with.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Don't mind me, you're free to head 
back first, you know?
choice_data_list:
I have to keep an eye on you to make sure 
you don't push yourself too hard.

I have to keep an eye on you to make sure 
you don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Tch, so that's what it is!
choice_data_list: 君が無理しないように見守っておかないと
貴方が無理しないように見守っておかないと
choice_data_list_en: I need to keep an eye on you so you don't push yourself too hard.
I need to keep an eye on you so you don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's reassuring having someone 
looking out for you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, take another look at my dancing! 
I've gotten pretty good at it, ya know?
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to the 'Ace's Dance'!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Let's give this a shot, then!!
choice_data_list: 『エースのダンス』、期待してるよ！
choice_data_list_en: I'm looking forward to the 'Ace Dance'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, with me watching over her, 
Katsuragi Ace seemed to deliver a dance 
she was fully satisfied with.
